title: Top 100 A0–A1 Semantic Master List (14 Languages)
dek: 100 progressive semantic chains across 10 ordered domains with milestone goals, monolingual definitions, and direct live links to COSYdata vocabulary repositories.

blocks.text:
01
💬 Domain 1: First Contact & Fundamental Dialogue

Courtesy & Communication

The starting point for every beginner. Unlocks greetings, politeness, digital actions, and core question words required on Day 1.

Chain 1 · Greetings A0 Level
👋 Hello ≠ 🚪 Goodbye
Chain 2 · Politeness A0 Level
🙏 Please ≠ 💐 Thank you
Chain 3 · Confirmation A0 Level
✅ Yes ≠ ❌ No
Chain 4 · Inquiry A0 Level
❓ Ask ≠ 💡 Answer
Chain 5 · Oral Communication A0 Level
👂 Listen ≠ 🗣️ Speak
Chain 6 · Literacy A0 Level
📖 Read ≠ ✍️ Write
Chain 7 · Phone Call A0 Level
📱 Call ➔ 💬 Talk ➔ 🤙 Hang up
Chain 8 · Digital Message A0 Level
💻 Open ➔ ⌨️ Type ➔ ✉️ Send
Chain 9 · Power Control A0 Level
🔌 Turn on ≠ 💡 Turn off
Chain 10 · Question Primitives A0 Level
❓ Who ➔ What ➔ Where ➔ When ➔ Why 🧐
🎯 Milestone 1 Can-Do Goal

Can greet others, ask basic question-word queries (Who/What/Where), perform polite requests, and handle initial contact.

02
👥 Domain 2: Self & Social Connections

People, Family & Identity

Moves from greetings into personal identity—enabling learners to introduce themselves, state their age group, and describe family relationships.

Chain 11 · Pronouns & Group A0 Level
🙋 Me ➔ 🫵 You ➔ 👥 Us
Chain 12 · Male Lifecycle A0 Level
👦 Boy ➔ 👨 Man
Chain 13 · Female Lifecycle A0 Level
👧 Girl ➔ 👩 Woman
Chain 14 · Gender Contrast A0 Level
👨 Man ≠ 👩 Woman
Chain 15 · Age Growth A0 Level
👶 Baby ➔ 🧒 Child ➔ 🧑 Adult
Chain 16 · Age Spectrum A0 Level
👶 Young ≠ 👵 Old
Chain 17 · Spouses A0 Level
🤵 Husband ≠ 👰 Wife
Chain 18 · Siblings A0 Level
👦 Brother ≠ 👧 Sister
Chain 19 · Family Tree A0 Level
👴 Grandparents ➔ 👨‍👩‍👧 Parents ➔ 🧒 Children
Chain 20 · Social Relations A0 Level
🤝 Friend ≠ 👤 Stranger
🎯 Milestone 2 Can-Do Goal

Can introduce oneself and others, state age categories, and identify core family relationships.

03
⏰ Domain 3: Temporal Grounding & Scheduling

Time, Calendar & Sequence

Anchors actions in time, navigation of calendars, frequency expressions, and event sequencing.

Chain 21 · Immediate Timeline A0 Level
⏳ Before ➔ ⏱️ Now ➔ ⌛ After
Chain 22 · Time of Day A0 Level
🌅 Morning ➔ ☀️ Afternoon ➔ 🌆 Evening ➔ 🌙 Night
Chain 23 · Relative Days A0 Level
⏮️ Yesterday ➔ 🔴 Today ➔ ⏭️ Tomorrow
Chain 24 · Duration Units A0 Level
⏱️ Minute ➔ ⏰ Hour ➔ 📅 Day
Chain 25 · Weekly Rhythm A0 Level
🗓️ Weekday ➔ 🥳 Weekend
Chain 26 · Four Seasons A0 Level
🌸 Spring ➔ ☀️ Summer ➔ 🍂 Autumn ➔ ❄️ Winter
Chain 27 · Time Horizons A0 Level
📜 Past ➔ 📍 Present ➔ 🔮 Future
Chain 28 · Sequential Order A0 Level
1️⃣ First ➔ 2️⃣ Next ➔ 🏁 Last
Chain 29 · Speed Scale A0 Level
🐢 Slow ➔ 🚶 Normal ➔ 🚀 Fast
Chain 30 · Frequency Spectrum A0 Level
🔄 Always ➔ 🔀 Sometimes ➔ 🚫 Never
🎯 Milestone 3 Can-Do Goal

Can tell relative time, specify days/seasons, set schedules, and sequence events logically.

04
🌅 Domain 4: Life Habits & Physical Controls

Daily Routine & Actions

Combines time and identity to describe personal habits, work schedules, and physical operational controls.

Chain 31 · Morning Wakeup A0 Level
⏰ Wake up ➔ 🛏️ Get up
Chain 32 · Hygiene A0 Level
🧼 Wash ➔ 🪥 Brush teeth
Chain 33 · Clothing Actions A0 Level
👔 Put on ≠ 🧥 Take off
Chain 34 · Workday Rhythm A0 Level
💼 Start work ➔ ☕ Break ➔ 🏠 Finish work
Chain 35 · Evening Transition A0 Level
🏠 Go home ➔ 🛋️ Relax
Chain 36 · Rest Cycle A0 Level
😴 Sleep ≠ ⏰ Wake up
Chain 37 · Execution Control A0 Level
▶️ Start ≠ ⏹️ Stop
Chain 38 · Access Control A0 Level
🔓 Open ≠ 🔒 Close
Chain 39 · Cleanliness State A0 Level
✨ Clean ≠ 🧹 Dirty
Chain 40 · Moisture State A0 Level
🌵 Dry ≠ 💧 Wet
🎯 Milestone 4 Can-Do Goal

Can describe a full daily routine from waking to sleeping and manage basic physical action controls.

05
🏡 Domain 5: Physical Environment & Living Quarters

Home & Living Spaces

Focuses on immediate surroundings—naming house types, rooms, furniture, and indoor/outdoor boundaries.

Chain 41 · Housing Types A0 Level
🏠 House ≠ 🏢 Apartment
Chain 42 · Home Entry & Rooms A0 Level
🚪 Door ➔ 🛋️ Living room ➔ 🛏️ Bedroom
Chain 43 · Dining Quarters A0 Level
🍳 Kitchen ➔ 🍽️ Dining room
Chain 44 · Spatial Location A0 Level
🛋️ Inside ≠ 🌳 Outside
Chain 45 · Basic Furniture A0 Level
🪵 Table ≠ 🪑 Chair
Chain 46 · Rest Furniture A0 Level
🛏️ Bed ➔ 💤 Sleep
Chain 47 · Security Objects A0 Level
🔑 Key ➔ 🔒 Lock
Chain 48 · Apertures A0 Level
🪟 Window ≠ 🚪 Door
Chain 49 · Room Structure A0 Level
🧱 Floor ≠ 🏠 Ceiling
Chain 50 · Illumination A0 Level
💡 Light ≠ 🌙 Dark
🎯 Milestone 5 Can-Do Goal

Can describe domestic spaces, name rooms and furniture, and specify indoor or outdoor locations.

06
🍽️ Domain 6: Survival Dining & Taste Communication

Food, Drink & Dining

Essential survival capability for ordering meals, expressing appetite, describing basic food types, and dining out.

Chain 51 · Appetite Flow A0 Level
😋 Hungry ➔ 🍽️ Eat ➔ 🫃 Full
Chain 52 · Daily Meals A0 Level
🥣 Breakfast ➔ 🥗 Lunch ➔ 🍲 Dinner
Chain 53 · Culinary Sequence A0 Level
🍳 Cook ➔ 🍽️ Eat ➔ 🧽 Wash dishes
Chain 54 · Produce Categories A0 Level
🍎 Fruit ≠ 🥦 Vegetable
Chain 55 · Protein Staples A0 Level
🥩 Meat ≠ 🐟 Fish
Chain 56 · Food Temperature A0 Level
🔥 Hot ≠ 🧊 Cold
Chain 57 · Seasoning Contrast A0 Level
🧂 Salt ≠ 🍬 Sugar
Chain 58 · Flavor Spectrum A0 Level
🍰 Sweet ≠ 🍋 Sour
Chain 59 · Hot Beverages A0 Level
☕ Coffee ≠ 🍵 Tea
Chain 60 · Dining Drinks A0 Level
🍷 Wine ≠ 🍺 Beer
🎯 Milestone 6 Can-Do Goal

Can navigate café and restaurant interactions, order food/drinks, and communicate dining preferences.

07
🛒 Domain 7: Commercial Autonomy & Payments

Shopping & Money

Unlocks economic independence—inquiring about prices, choosing goods, understanding discounts, and paying.

Chain 61 · Shopping Intent A0 Level
💭 Need ➔ 🔍 Choose ➔ 🛒 Buy
Chain 62 · Store Venue Types A0 Level
🛒 Supermarket ➔ 🥦 Market
Chain 63 · Store Status A0 Level
🚪 Open ≠ 🔒 Closed
Chain 64 · Store Roles A0 Level
👤 Customer ≠ 🧑‍💼 Cashier
Chain 65 · Price & Sale A0 Level
🏷️ Price ≠ 🏷️ Discount
Chain 66 · Price Scale A0 Level
💸 Cheap ≠ 💎 Expensive
Chain 67 · Package Sizing A0 Level
🤏 Small ≠ 🐘 Large
Chain 68 · Payment Options A0 Level
💳 Card ≠ 💵 Cash
Chain 69 · Checkout Flow A0 Level
🛍️ Buy ➔ 🧾 Pay ➔ 🛍️ Take home
Chain 70 · Money Management A0 Level
💰 Earn ➔ 🏦 Save ➔ 🛍️ Spend
🎯 Milestone 7 Can-Do Goal

Can shop independently, ask for costs, choose between payment methods (card/cash), and handle exchanges.

08
🗺️ Domain 8: Mobility & Spatial Exploration

Travel & City Navigation

Expands independence beyond home and shop to urban transit, directions, transit tickets, and accommodations.

Chain 71 · Relative Position A0 Level
📍 Here ≠ 🫵 There
Chain 72 · Distance Scale A0 Level
📏 Near ≠ 🔭 Far
Chain 73 · Direction Vectors A0 Level
⬅️ Left ➔ ⬆️ Straight ➔ ➡️ Right
Chain 74 · Map Search A0 Level
🗺️ Map ➔ 📍 Location
Chain 75 · Transit Hierarchy A0 Level
🚌 Bus ➔ 🚆 Train ➔ ✈️ Plane
Chain 76 · Transit Boarding A0 Level
🚉 Station ➔ 🚉 Platform
Chain 77 · Travel Ticket A0 Level
🎟️ Ticket ➔ 🧳 Journey
Chain 78 · Trip Movement A0 Level
🛬 Arrive ≠ 🛫 Leave
Chain 79 · Settlement Scale A0 Level
🏙️ City ≠ 🏡 Village
Chain 80 · Accommodation A0 Level
🏨 Hotel ≠ 🛏️ Hostel
🎯 Milestone 8 Can-Do Goal

Can navigate urban spaces, ask for and follow directions, buy transit tickets, and check into lodging.

09
🩺 Domain 9: Physical Well-Being & Medical Care

Health & Body

Critical safety net capability—identifying body parts, indicating symptoms, visiting doctors, and getting medicine.

Chain 81 · Facial Anatomy A0 Level
👤 Face ➔ 👁️ Eyes ➔ 👃 Nose ➔ 👄 Mouth
Chain 82 · Upper Extremities A0 Level
🖐️ Hand ➔ 🖐️ Fingers
Chain 83 · Lower Extremities A0 Level
🦶 Foot ➔ 🦶 Toes
Chain 84 · Limbs Contrast A0 Level
🦾 Arm ≠ 🦵 Leg
Chain 85 · Health Condition A0 Level
🏃 Healthy ≠ 🤒 Sick
Chain 86 · Symptom & Relief A0 Level
🩺 Pain ➔ 💊 Medicine
Chain 87 · Recovery Cycle A0 Level
🌡️ Fever ➔ 🛌 Rest ➔ 🔋 Recover
Chain 88 · Medical Facility A0 Level
👨‍⚕️ Doctor ➔ 🏥 Hospital ➔ 💊 Pharmacy
Chain 89 · Care Journey A0 Level
🤒 Sick ➔ 👨‍⚕️ Doctor ➔ 💊 Medicine
Chain 90 · Hygiene Routine A0 Level
🧼 Wash hands ➔ 🧻 Dry hands
🎯 Milestone 9 Can-Do Goal

Can explain health symptoms, point out body parts, visit pharmacies or doctors, and follow basic care steps.

10
🌟 Domain 10: Descriptive Mastery & Emotional Nuance

Feelings, Qualities & Opposites

Capstone domain—providing emotional depth, qualitative evaluations, intensity contrasts, and complete A0 fluency.

Chain 91 · Primary Emotions A0 Level
😄 Happy ≠ 😢 Sad
Chain 92 · Emotional Intensity A0 Level
🧘 Calm ≠ 😡 Angry
Chain 93 · Consciousness State A0 Level
😴 Awake ≠ 💤 Asleep
Chain 94 · Basic Evaluation A0 Level
👍 Good ≠ 👎 Bad
Chain 95 · Task Complexity A0 Level
🟢 Easy ≠ 🔴 Difficult
Chain 96 · Size Scale A0 Level
🐘 Big ≠ 🐁 Small
Chain 97 · Stature Scale A0 Level
📏 Short ≠ 🦒 Tall
Chain 98 · Capacity State A0 Level
📦 Full ≠ 📭 Empty
Chain 99 · Safety State A0 Level
🔒 Safe ≠ ⚠️ Dangerous
Chain 100 · A0 Mastery Capstone A0 Level
💯 100 Words ➔ 🎯 A0 Mastery!
🎯 Milestone 10 Can-Do Goal

Possesses a complete 100-chain foundational vocabulary map across 10 progressive real-life domains!
